subject: conditional panel based on renderPlot output?

messages.author: adc05d3187e2b592
messages.subject: conditional panel based on renderPlot output?
parts:
Hi All,

I have an app where I would like to display a download button only if a plot has been rendered.

I've placed the button in a conditional panel like so:

conditionalPanel(condition = "output.histPlot", downloadButton(...), ...)

where histPlot is produced by:

output$histPlot = renderPlot({ ... plot code ... })

When I run my app, the button is displayed when the plot is not - basically ignoring the condition.
Am I missing something here?

Thanks,
Lee

messages.author: adc05d3187e2b592
messages.subject: Re: conditional panel based on renderPlot output?
parts:
SOLUTION:

The condition I was setting condition = "output.histPlot" tests if the histPlot output container has internal content.  In the case of plots, this would be an img tag.  However, when an app is launched, there is blank (white) placeholder img in place, thus the condition returns TRUE.

To get around this, I added the following to my ui.R:

uiOutput('plotDone')

and the following to my server.R:

output$histPlot = renderPlot({
  output$plotDone <<- renderUI({tags$input(type="hidden", value="TRUE")})

... plot code ...
})

I can now set the condition for my conditional panel as:

conditionalPanel(condition = "output.plotDone", downloadButton(...), ...)

Lee
